anatomy.authority: ANAT1 MediaPipe 468-point face mask supplies the lower jaw / cheek / temple chain from its 36-index reference ring. The skull vault is NOT in that mask: it is separately authored from observed cranial proportions using 8 new parietal/frontal arch anchors.
anatomy.caveat: Sex parameter is a mesh morph parameter, not an individual's inferred sex or identity. No reference-aligned anatomy fidelity claim; the model face mask excludes skull back/ears/hairline.
anatomy.diagnostics: Nine projected NEW-HEAD ANAT1 points (forehead, glabella, both zygions, cheekbones, gonions, menton) computed through the same source-of-truth projectNewHeadPoint as the subject. NOT 18 retired-woman landmarks or independent source/actual-image comparisons.

character_spec.geometry: One completely new 3D face-mask lower jaw/temple chain plus eight separately authored frontal/parietal vault anchors: head outline only, not filled dermis. 3 independent transparent dry-pencil optical passes with 342 small construction contacts and five measured guide marks, no eyes, nose, mouth, hair, ear or former female geometry.
character_spec.one_at_a_time_gate: No second character or facial feature before stage-1 silhouette is rendered at 1x/2.15x, proportion/plane masks reviewed, and any topology defect corrected.

character_spec.pigment_study: Generic CP1 glaze made a repeated diagonal grid over the entire head at native film size. The candidate uses three independent granular low-pressure optical passes instead, retains 342 separately curved face-plane marks and shades the silhouette with a measured fine sepia boundary. No photography pixels or filter.

five_axes.topology: one editable standalone head, no old portrait parts and no face stickers. Mark visible missing cranium behind the mask as blocker, not as finished skull. five_axes.vector_flow: 3 curved local pressure fans run from forehead through zygomatic bones to jaw; no global diagonal identical strokes
five_axes.weight: Stage 1 outline now intentionally .82 paper units / .56 opacity sepia in the existing CP-F1 renderer, paired with optical stipple; no solid skin support or opaque salmon wax.
five_axes.rhythm: 3 × 114 short strokes follow three bony guides with deterministic irregular offsets, not wallpaper
five_axes.texture: Previous 1× native frame had uniform diagonal hatch lattice, not authentic pencil drawing. New candidate replaces universal hatch/fiber pattern in this ONE glaze with pressure-bounded paper-tooth stipple contacts; three independently authored curved construction fans remain. No claim of photorealism or release without current-head screenshot.

visual_review_log.candidate: prior original single head under CP-F1 default glaze — native one-to-one ArtCraft negative review
visual_review_log.observed: Opened actual artcraft-living-portrait-landscape.png. Whole head is a tall broad face shield with almost no distinguishable cheek-to-jaw turn. Across the head, three long diagonal CP1 hatch families form a uniform checker/plaid rather than shaped low-pressure coloured-pencil deposits. Facial value guides are almost invisible at native output.
visual_review_log.cause: The compatibility glaze inherits generic full-region global hatching, especially three crossed angles, plus near invisible .09 contour opacity. This defeats the separately authored value-guide marks and makes the new ANAT1 silhouette read as flat painted paper.
visual_review_log.correction: For new head ONLY set 3 optical layers to fine paper-tooth stipple with pressures below .3, preserve all 342 curved bone-aligned gestures, and use .82-unit warm sepia outline at .56 opacity. Review full native image again. Next actual form correction: independent rights-verified 3/4 head source and measured posterior vault, frontal arc/temple, zygoma/gonion and chin silhouettes; source-traced paint or old woman re-use prohibited.
